STREET, WAVELAND PL., PINETREE ST., HOWE ALLEY, QUINCE / AL., BLOOM ST., WAVERLY ... AVENUE, TREMONT ... STREET, LAWNWAY ST., AMTHAUER ST., 'AVE.' (diagonal, unnamed here). Liddell/Linden/Judson/Dempsey junction at (7309,2670) is an irregular five-way box, ~15 px. Beekman's heavy line (streetcar track) used as its centreline.
